proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12815 sa/so explicitly gives Maiyan soh and regional so he. Maiyan/Gowro so he selects the simple pronoun, not 13607 so api he also, which adds an emphatic particle unsupported by these forms. Exact survey form so is preserved.
